scope: R2-0 and R2-1 only; stop after Gate
sign: native decoder v flipped exactly once; CW-positive T
unit: official model or independent custom training seed; phases/checkpoints repeated within unit
selection: Reuse the fixed Rev02/03 official000–009 index cohort, not a random sample of official50; no phenotype re-selection.
bootstrap: 10000 whole-model row resamples; fixed phase columns retained; percentile95%; conditional robustness intervals, not official50 population intervals.
pixel_contract: Actual Rev02/03 cached uint8 382x382; center190.5; ring55/382; white255; no crop, AA, interpolation or dtype conversion; reuse src stimulus generator only to verify saved images.
mapping: All reflected O/M across12 stored phases against all opposite-variant phases; choose minimum full-image MAE, ties minimum phase index; also report annulus MAE and RMS normalized by255.
case_rule: CASE A if the continuous sector order is Mirror-equivalent and any discrete residual pixels are confined to analytically identified sector boundaries; CASE B for non-boundary structural differences. Exact and effective equivalence are reported separately.
T_comparison: Only measured Rev03 phase0 LR responses versus Rev02 best-matching phase, both variants, model-wise. Other reflected phases have pixel-only comparison; do not fabricate responses.
